meta.description:
Heart is your go-to destination for heartfelt K-Dramas from sweet romances and quirky comedies to soul-touching human stories. This channel is for viewers who seek joy, comfort, and connection through relatable characters and storytelling.

Shows: Kill me, Heal me Ep.3, Kill me, Heal me Ep.19, Kill me, Heal me Ep.20, Lucky Romance Ep.1, Lucky Romance Ep.2
